tree.label: Product feedback loop
tree.gloss: The system that turns observed experience into product change.

children.label: Capture
children.gloss: Collects reports, observations, and behavioral signals.

children.label: Interpretation
children.gloss: Groups evidence, tests explanations, and establishes priority.
children.cohesion_basis: Conversion of raw evidence into warranted product claims.

children.label: Intervention
children.gloss: Changes the product and observes the resulting behavior.
children.cohesion_basis: Translation of warranted claims into tested change.

population_sanity.note: The subject has differentiated stages rather than peer members.

paradigm_sweep.note: Medium mode compared the two live candidates without a full sweep.

native_n_array.note: The candidate dispute concerned principle, not nearby child counts.

one_ply_lookahead.note: Likely child capabilities remain within their parent stages.

kind_homogeneity.note: All root children are transformation stages.

seam_straddlers.reason: It is captured evidence, but its defining role is measuring an intervention.

judgment_calls.decision: Use transformation stage rather than team ownership.
judgment_calls.reason: Ownership changes more readily than the feedback transformations.
